name: Firebase App Hosting
line: Build and host full-stack web apps with Google's managed platform.

free.text: Blaze required; first 10GiB App Hosting delivery/month is free

cells.regions: Iowa, Virginia, Ohio, Taiwan, Singapore, Netherlands

work.math: Delivery alone is $12.4698 if cached, or $16.6265 if not cached, after the 10 GiB allowance. Cloud Run, images, logs and storage prevent an exact total.
A subtotal of $19.5065 that depends on conditions. It assumes 300,000 billed CPU seconds and uncached delivery. Request pattern, startup, images and logs vary.
The small app API subtotal of $19.5065, plus $27.2500 for Cloud SQL compute and storage = $46.7565 before backups, logs, images and other missing charges.
